verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents rosbag recording and a Python API for reading and writing bags, and notes that bags can store synthetic data for training sets. That is only a data-capture building block. The evidence shows no model-training integration and no mechanism for deploying an improved model back to a robot fleet, so the closed-loop story is not delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed collected robot data into model training and deploy the improved model back to the fleet
